args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money's docstring specified banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
per FIN-212, but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing
tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build (e.g. 2.665 should
round to 2.66, not 2.67). Correct the rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.body:
## Summary
Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` caused by `round_money` in `src/money.py` not implementing banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212.

The docstring already documented ROUND_HALF_EVEN, but the implementation used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, so `Decimal("2.665")` rounded to 2.67 instead of the expected 2.66.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: import and apply `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` when quantizing to cents.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
